# Negative-control fixture for c2s-rescue/scripts/check-marker-reachability.py
#
# objdump -d --disassemble=primary_entry of the PRE-FIX diagnostic vmlinux:
# the diag5 candidate (boot.img 852e868d1e4c3a9d...), whose head.S placed
# the M1b green band between the '0:' and '1:' labels of primary_entry, so
# the MMU-off entry path's 'b 1f' jumped over the whole M1b block.  Every
# byte-level gate passed on that build; the green band could never appear
# on the device's own entry path.
#
# The checker must REJECT this listing: M1b-green is not reachable on the
# cache-off path.  If it ever reports RESULT: PASS the gate has become
# insensitive and the regression is no longer guarded.
